propositions: An empty ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets whose relation graph is walked.
The error names the broken ticket (orphan directory) rather than the ticket being reviewed, creating a misleading wrong-direction signal during debugging.
Event-less directories persist invisibly in local clones because git cannot track empty directories, so they do not appear in git status and cannot be repaired by pulling.
The reducer should tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the entire snapshot and stalling plan reviews across an epic.

The writer creates ticket directories before writing their first event, leaving orphans when process death occurs during the staging window, but writer-side cleanup is both unsafe under concurrent writes and unable to repair existing broken clones.
